en: ...Snow?
There's snow here...

Whoa! It's snow! Look, Maki Roll!
It's snow! Look! Snow!
Are you a dog?
Is it...cold here? Our avatars can feel cold?
Yep! Isn't it great!?

Not only can you feel cold, but you can
even feel pain and pleasure too!

In fact, you don't even need to use birth
control here!

Hey...try to be quiet, please. I feel like the
more you talk, the more I'll dislike you.

How about we start by exploring the
rooftop?
Yeah, let's do that.

It's snow, Shuichi! It's snow! Snow!
It's piling up everywhere! Look!
Y-Yeah!
<CLT=cltMIND>He really is like an excited puppy...

From up here, you can observe everything
quite clearly.

Let's look for anything that might catch
our eye.

Although we've checked the map thoroughly,
it was created by Miu...

There may be other things she has forgotten
to tell us, if you catch my meaning.

The cold and the snow...and even this
cloudy sky is sort of refreshing.
Since we've been trapped in the academy...

How can you get so excited over snow?
You're not a kid anymore...

Hey, Maki Roll.
Men are...

...living things that must cherish their 
playful heart! If they lose that, they'll age!

...I thought you said when men lose their
curiosity, they'll age.

Yeah, they're both important! A man's got
a lot to remember! Isn't that right, bro?
I...don't know how to respond to that.

I don't mind if you're excited, but we should
search for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

I-It's cold... I'm going to catch a cold being 
in the snow wearing such light clothes.

Or wait...? Maybe we can't catch colds 
as avatars?

But...we're definitely feeling cold. I wonder
if that's enough to make our real bodies sick.
That reminds me of a study I once read...

People were told they were going to be splashed
with hot water, but cold water was used instead.

But their minds were so convinced, their
bodies reacted as if the water was boiling.

Oh, I've heard of something like 
that before, too.

So maybe we can catch a cold from this 
after all. It might be good to be careful.

We might catch colds from this after all, 
so it'd be best to be careful.

Right? Isn't this place great?
You can slut it up all you want here!
Like I said before...please try to be quiet.
<CLT=cltMIND>Mounted binoculars?

Man, looks like you've got a lot of experience
with binoculars!

Hah-haha! You're such an obvious peeping
Tom!

<CLT=cltMIND>I have a lot of experience with binoculars?
What does that mean...?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can see pretty far with
these mounted binoculars!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>I mean...duh. They're binoculars.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Feel free to look around with them!
Get a good look at everything!
<CLT=cltMIND>I should check out the roof.

<CLT=cltMIND>This looks like a storage room...
I suppose I should check inside.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll head outside.
<CLT=cltMIND>Hm? The binoculars can't see past here.
Ah, is this...where the line on the map was?
I told you, it's not a line!

Then...what is it?
Why do the binoculars stop there?

Krgh... Aggressive men are always coming
and going and coming too soon.

I'll explain it to you when we get there, so
don't get your panties in a bind.

<CLT=cltMIND>What is she talking about?
What could be over there?

<CLT=cltMIND>The binoculars can't see past here.
What is Miu hiding?

Well? Did you manage to examine all the
places that caught your eye?

Yes, but there weren't too many
points of interest.

Aaah, it's really cold. I didn't think 
it'd be snowing.

Nice, Himiko! That means if you trip and
hit your head, it won't hurt!

Don't be rude! I'm not the type 
to trip that often—
...That's way too cliched of a gag.

Snow and a mansion... How ominous.
*sigh* Great job, killing game simulator.

But...we're not leaving any footprints in it.
What's up with that?

It was probably programmed like that. It'd be
easy to find the culprit from the footprints.

Yeah...looks that way. But you don't need
to worry about it.

This is just a simulation and there are no
dangerous items here whatsoever.

Let's go outside! We can cross the river
and head to the chapel!

But how do we cross the river?
I don't remember seeing any bridges...

Geez, you're so fucking stupid, you're
approaching savant-'tard territory...

Let's just go over there so I can explain it
to you idiots all at once!
Keebo? Is something wrong?

Well...I was just looking at that wall, and
I started to think about what Miu said...
About how <CLT=cltSTRONG>nothing exists<CLT=cltNORMAL> beyond that wall.

And then, I started to think about the wall
that surrounds the academy...
Oh, no...never mind. Forget what I just said.

We should get going. If we're late, Miu will
chew us out with vulgar profanities.
